description: Conformance cases for the data contract (ADR 0004). The TypeScript models and the Python reference models must both accept exactly the cases marked valid. For valid cases, contract/conformance.expected.json holds the Python reference's canonical output, which the TypeScript output must equal. Paths may be fixture files; 'select' picks a part of the fixture; 'patch' applies set, remove, and duplicate (append a copy of an array element) in order. A negative index counts from the end.
